description: This file declares the dm_sta_t class, which manages station (STA) information in a Wi-Fi network context. It includes methods for initializing, encoding/decoding JSON, parsing station radio info, capability decoding, and handling beacon reports. The class encapsulates station data and provides interfaces for interacting with Wi-Fi station attributes.
